description: Automated cert issuance via RFC 8555. Each kithd gets a real WebPKI cert for its DNS name from Let's Encrypt (or other ACME CA). Standard TLS just works — no custom verifiers, no cert pinning required. identify_caller extracts identity from the verified TLS hostname. Pairs naturally with DNS-based discovery (KITH-beps): if you have a DNS name, you can get a cert for it. Requires the kithd operator to have a publicly resolvable domain and port 443 or DNS-01 challenge support.
title: Auth mechanism: ACME (Let's Encrypt)
